E1_equivalence.interpretation: AI and human TD density are statistically equivalent within the pre-specified small-effect margin

unrestricted.interpretation: equivalence not established at the chosen margin

E6_power.interpretation: With n1=1083 and n2=100 the design has 80% power to detect |delta| >= 0.169. The observed delta is -0.042 and its 95% CI lies inside the negligible band (|delta| < 0.147), so an effect of small magnitude or larger can be ruled out even though exact equivalence on the mean-difference scale is not established (see E1).

unrestricted.interpretation: With n1=1083 and n2=100 the design has 80% power to detect |delta| >= 0.169. The observed delta is 0.027 and its 95% CI lies inside the negligible band (|delta| < 0.147), so an effect of small magnitude or larger can be ruled out even though exact equivalence on the mean-difference scale is not established (see E1).
